summary: Sandbach United are looking to make it back-to-back home wins as they host New Mills this evening, carrying momentum from their narrow victory over Stafford Town on Saturday. The squad remains unchanged for the fixture, with the team confident despite facing a tough test in warm conditions. Kick-off is at 7:45pm with admission at £6 for adults, £5 for concessions, and £2 for under-16s.
